# symbol_level_anchor_granularity

Anchor overlap matching uses symbol-path granularity when both candidate and target anchors include symbol_path; otherwise it uses file-path granularity. Renames update symbol_path prefixes to preserve symbol-level overlap across file renames.

Ensure anchor-based identity remains robust across file renames and uses the most precise granularity available.
